description: Change of use from Use Class C3 (dwelling house) to Use Class C1 short stay accommodation (RETROSPECTIVE).
decision_conditions: The retrospective change of use results in the loss of a property that would be more appropriately occupied as a single family dwelling house and undermines the need to ensure that a range of housing types are available within the Borough with particular regard to the need to provide appropriate accommodation for family occupation. The existing change of use is thereby contrary to Policies DMD3, DMD4 and DMD31 of the Development Management Document (2014), CP5, CP12 and CP30 of the Core Strategy (2010) and H1, H8 and H10 of the London Plan (2021) as well as the advice contained within the NPPF (2026).

Insufficient information has been submitted by way of a site specific Flood Risk Assessment to demonstrate that the development would be safe from flooding and that the retrospective ground floor bedrooms would not be impacted by a flooding event. In addition, the submission fails to clarify the required Finished Floor Level (FFL) and Flood Evacuation Plan or SuDS mitigations within the scheme. The development is therefore contrary to the relevant flood-risk provisions of the National Planning Policy Framework (2026), Policies SI 12 and SI 13 of the London Plan (2021), Core Policy CP28 of the Core Strategy (2010) and Policies DMD 59, DMD 60 and DMD 61 of the Development Management Document (2014).

The existing development with associated servicing and deliveries would not be commensurate with the current use and it would thereby constitute an overdevelopment of the site that would give rise to conditions prejudicial to the free flow and safety of vehicular traffic and unsafe pedestrian movements.  Furthermore, the proposal fails to secure the necessary mechanism to prevent future occupiers from obtaining Controlled Parking Zone (CPZ) parking permits and does not make provision for the associated monitoring. The proposal would be contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2026), Policies DF1, T2, T4 and T6.1 of the London Plan (2021), Policies CP24, CP25 and CP46 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), Policies DMD45, DMD47 and DMD48 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014) and The Enfield Section 106 Supplementary Planning Document (SPD) (2016).

The change of use, by virtue of increase in activity, comings and goings, general noise and disturbance associated with the existing short stay accommodation would detract from the residential character and amenities enjoyed by the occupants of the neighbouring residential properties. This would be contrary to Policies CP12 and CP30 of the Core Strategy (2010), Policies DMD4, DMD8, DMD31, DMD37 and DMD68 of the Development Management Document (2014), Policy D14 of the London Plan (2021) as well as the objectives of the NPPF (2026).
